sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Hill Tract Improvement Ordinance Repeal Act 1989
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XI OF 1989
ACT XI OF 1989
BALOCHISTAN HILL TRACT IMPROVEMENT ORDINANCE (REPEAL) ACT, 1989
An Act to repeal the Balochistan Hill Tract Ordinance, 1961
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 28th November; 1989]
No.PAB/LEGIS: 111(14)/89, dated
28-i1-1989.--The Balochistan Hill Tract Improvement Ordinance (Repeal) Bill,
1989 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 18th
October, 1989 and assented to by the Governor of Balochistan, is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Balochistan Hill Tract Improvement Ordinance (Repeal) Act, 1989.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 1st day of December, 1984.
